authoredSolutions.86: The letters of FARMER are \(A,E,F,M,R,R\). Total arrangements \(=\dfrac{6!}{2!}=360\); those with the two R's together \(=5!=120\), so the number of valid words \(=240\). List alphabetically. Words beginning with \(A\) or \(E\): each fixes a non-R first letter, giving \(\dfrac{5!}{2!}-4!=36\) valid words, so \(72\) words precede every F-word. Now fix \(F\) and arrange \(\{A,E,M,R,R\}\). The second letter \(A\) is smallest, so nothing precedes on it. With \(FA\) fixed, arrange \(\{E,M,R,R\}\): a third letter smaller than \(R\) is \(E\) or \(M\), each admitting exactly one no-adjacent-R arrangement (\(RMR\) and \(RER\)) \(=2\) words. With \(FAR\) fixed, the placed \(R\) forbids an adjacent \(R\), so a fourth letter smaller than \(M\) can only be \(E\), giving \(2\) words. With \(FARM\) fixed the remaining \(E,R\) yield \(FARMER\) next. Hence the serial number \(=72+2+2+1=77\).
